name: Speculated Raytracing Kernel Inputs Construction
definition: Construction of inputs for the raytracing kernel when speculation is enabled, introducing an offset buffer O_Spec to handle non-unique ray IDs caused by repeated ray IDs in the active ray ID buffer.
summary: Speculated Raytracing Kernel Inputs Construction generates unique indices for multiple ray-block intersections, enabling accurate isosurface visualization in massive volumes by resolving non-unique ray identifiers.
